A guest from Gujarat named Govardhan Bhai, along with his mischievous grandson Deepu and driver, gets stranded in Mumbai due to car trouble. Since they strictly eat home-cooked food, Sodhi invites them to his house for dinner while the car gets repaired at his garage.
